notes.title: YOW - FULL release
notes.notes:
[b]We are proud that we arrived an important milestone in the life of the game. We had level up from the state of Early access![/b]
Let us introduce the official version of the game and the major features:

[list]
[*] [b]25 missions[/b] with a final BossFight!
[*][b] Awesome visual[/b] upgrade and new cartoon style
[*] [b]Dynamics day/night[/b] changing
[*][b] More themes added[/b]: artic, jungle, tropic island, volcano
[*] [b]New game mode[/b]: endless fun with Balloon Hunting
[*] [b]Physics updated[/b]
[*] [b]New in-game elements[/b] added: like buttons, moving platforms, intractable objects
[*] [b]Moving enemies[/b] added
[*] [b]New siege machine[/b] added: ballista
[*] [b]New projectiles[/b]: 
               -bomber
               -teleport
               -nuke bomb
               -smart bomb

[/list]
